diagnostic: 30 constructed source continuations; no LLM; not an official upstream benchmark

gate.rule: Zero unsupported verification; correctness/coverage at least rerun-all; 20% total measured cost improvement; a check-set tie fails regardless of timing noise.

limitations: Thirty authored continuations across five pure-Python projects are not an official or statistically representative benchmark.
No language model, agent task success, remote state, undeclared dependency discovery or model-cost improvement is evaluated.
Dependencies are manually declared and conservative; installed transitive dependencies remain outside the claimed scope.
One environment and one timing observation per method/episode do not establish a stable production speedup.
The strong content-invalidation baseline is expected to select the same checks; this diagnostic can establish integration correctness without algorithmic superiority.
Local receipts and clocks are not cryptographic proof of execution or public issuance.
